target_customer: Remote and distributed tech companies that pay per attendee for a planned company retreat
problem: Planning a company retreat means sourcing venues, negotiating contracts, booking room blocks and running logistics, which is slow and painful for small remote teams.
business_model: Service-led marketplace: fee per retreat built around a planning dashboard plus human retreat designers; venue and travel commissions possible but unconfirmed

founders.name: Harris Stolzenberg
founders.background_notes: Investment banker, then chief of staff at an early-stage startup, then associate at Pear VC, per the YC page.

founders.name: Jared Hanson
founders.background_notes: Former Apple software engineer, per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A planning dashboard and booking workflow is ordinary web engineering; the hard part was operations and venue relationships, not software.

defensibility.rationale: Service heavy with human designers, so copying was easy for event planners; the only edge is venue relationships and repeat clients.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found showing an incumbent copied or bought the wedge. The retreat business still operates under flok.com as of 2025.

market_need_then: Remote and distributed teams grew sharply in 2020 and 2021, creating demand for in-person gatherings, but no sourced spend data was found.

branding.domain_note: Started on goflok.com, which now redirects (301) to flok.com, so the exact .com was acquired or migrated at an unknown date.

identity.voice_and_tone: Marketing copy is strategy-first and corporate in recent site pages

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand itself was found, and several unrelated companies share the name Flok or similar, which dilutes search.

outcome_analysis: YC lists Flok as acquired, but no acquirer, date or price could be found. A CB Insights entry claiming a Wix subsidiary appears to describe a different, older Israeli company named Flok, so it is not used. The flok.com site is still active in 2025 with a services-led retreat offering, so the exit may be small or an unannounced deal. Too little is public to assign causes.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights snippets show $0.13M seed (Jan 2021) and a $12.2M total on a different page, likely a different Flok; neither recorded as a round. Wix acquisition claim is likely about another company. No dated competitor search results found; list left empty.
